'''Gold Squadron''' was a [[New Jedi Order|Jedi]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] squadron active in [[44 ABY]]. Gold Squadron's [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] flew [[StealthX]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].

==History==
Gold Squadron, led by Jedi Master [[Kyle Katarn]], fought in the [[Operation Shieldfall|battle]] against the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] and [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]] over [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]]. During the [[Starfighter combat/Legends|combat]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Raynar Thul]] was shot down and forced to eject. Nevertheless, Thul continued to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|guide]] a [[Jedi shadow bomb|shadow bomb]] he had fired, and it detonated, damaging Ship as the Meditation Sphere fled.
